text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought 54,000 tonnes of Brazilian or Argentine soybeans at 168.90 cents over CBOT September futures from Cargill Tuesday, traders said. Shipment was for August 21 to September 10 shipment from an unspecified South American port.
WHEAT SALES - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Tuesday bought 12,000 tonnes of European bread-making wheat from Glencore Grain Rotterdam at $149.75 per tonne, C&F.

WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Korea Flour Milling Corp said Tuesday it bought 16,900 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Kanematsu Corp. The company passed on another 16,900 tonnes due to price, a Korea Flour official said. Shipment was for August 5-September 5 from the Pacific Northwest. The deal included 5,100 tonnes of soft white wheat at $140.35 per tonne, 2,600 at $139.25, 4,400 hard red winter at $146.35; and 4,800 dark northern spring at $170.95. All prices are FOB.

WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan Flour Mills Assn on Friday will seek two 33,000-tonne shipments of U.S. wheat, association officials said. One shipment is for July 15 to July 30 delivery from the Pacific Northwest (PNW) and the second for August 5 to August 20 from the PNW. The first shipment is to include 21,900 tonnes of dark northern spring, 9,100 hard red winter and 2,000 white wheat. The second shipment is to include 19,800 of dark northern spring, 9,000 of hard red winter, and 4,200 white wheat.
- The CCC said it seeks July 1 60,000 tonnes of US HRW wheat for July 16-31 shipment for donation to Kyrgyzstan.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan is to tender June 25 for 500,000 tonnes of optional origin white wheat, July 11-August 10 shipment, a spokesman at the country's U.S. embassy in Washington said. He said the wheat would be either from the United States, Australia or Canada.
BARLEY TENDERS - Saudi Arabia will tender on Tuesday for one million tonnes of feed barley of optional origin, European grain traders said. The barley is for delivery in September and October.
- Iran seeks 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley Tuesday night for October shipment, European traders said.

PALM OIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian and/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August. The bid deadline is 0900 GMT on June 25. The oils were in lots of 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin and 15,000 tonnes of palm oil.

MARKET TALK - The Canadian Wheat Board was not likely to supply much feed barley or soft wheat sought by Saudi Arabia, Algeria and Iran in tenders this week, a cash grain source said. "The Board gave the trade one cargo of barley to sell. They're having trouble getting barley, farmers just aren't delivering," the source said.

- USDA is close to signing a fiscal 1997 PL480 food aid agreement with Pakistan that will provide $10 million for purchases of U.S. soymeal, a USDA aide said Tuesday. Contracts to buy U.S. commodities under the PL480 must be signed by September 30, the end of the fiscal year. Delivery of the commodities must take place by December 31.
